decisions.reason: The matcher's «Поехали.»@3.5 means 'Let's go'. That is Andriy's line (item 0), not 'Home, Hek', so it fails on meaning. The reader's claim held up. An unprompted verify re-decode (no prompt, original audio) gives «Домой.»@14.84 (p=0.77). The vocals stem has a clear burst at 15.6–16.2 (−37 dB against a −70 dB floor) and a second small burst at 16.7–16.8, which fits «Домой… Гек». The time is in order (after item 0 at 3.5, before item 3) and inside the Boulders cue (8–176, Hek and Frania at home).

The matcher spread the line over 4.9–106.9 and matched Serhii's and the sister's words («пластика… ступы», «как он рос»), so no part of its match means this line. I ran my own unprompted check on the vocals stem (97–106, no prompt), which gives «если люди будут плакать, то будет много…»: люди@100.62, будут@101.40, плакать@101.60. That confirms the reader's «люди будут плакать»@100.78 and matches 'we won't cry'. The longer 84–104 verify windows only hallucinated («Дякую за перегляд!»), so the opening clause ('our dinner will be unconventional… videos') is still unrecognised. The start of 92 is an estimate for that opener, about 8 s before 'cry', and is roughly ±4 s. The line is in order before Frania's 'Home!' (107.5) and Serhii's «Так, сейчас»@109.44, and it falls inside cue 3 (memorial luncheon, 2–279).

The matcher's 176 is interpolated and rests on item 11's words («Ну, я уже дельтешу… поднятый лоскут»). It also falls before Nikolaich's item 12 «Поля?»@180.5, so it breaks playback order. The reader's «Гемостаз»@229.26 came only with a prompt, and the longer unprompted windows (verify 221–241, mine 224–236 and 227–232) only hallucinate («Редактор субтитров…», «Субтитры…»). That is '(Ге)мостаз… да-да', which agrees with the reader's «Гемостаз»@229.26 and «Да-да»@229.8. The time is in order (after item 12, which ends around 224, and before Sania at about 259) and inside cue 4 (Serhii, 109–293). The end is an estimate.

decisions.reason: The line opens with "everything written here is correct? Form 100", and the recognition has «Тут в сапарі написано, форма 100.» from 506.62 to 509.86 ("here in the [record] it is written, form 100"). Next comes «Травму отримували під час виконання бойового … 4-го»@510.4 (injury received on active duty on the 4th), then «обстрілу»@515.44 (shelling). The matcher started at «Перша допомога на етапах … з 5-го по 9-й»@515.94, which is the line's fourth sentence, so it skipped the first ~9s. decisions.reason: Matcher anchors on «А так вообще Богдан уникальный получился»@1590.31, which is the line's second sentence ('And you know, what made Bohdan really stand out'). The line opens 'Yeah, yeah', Levin's answer to Ian's 'only artist' question. That answer is «И@1584.77 он, у меня как бы… только, я не знаю, один, если считать». It is first-person answer content, not a question. The targeted pass hears it in one breath with the next sentence: «…тільки один, якщо вважати, а так взагалі Богдан унікальний…»@1585.0. In the vocals stem the voice from 1585.4 to 1588.4 sits at about 100–110 Hz, the same as at 1591.0 (about 105 Hz), so it is one speaker. 1584.77 also fits the order (114 at 1581.2, 116 at 1610.0). The opening 'Kitty-kitty, come here, come, little one! Come here' must come before it. The vocals stem is near-silent from 1623 to 1637.4 (about -55 to -67 dB). Speech starts at 1637.6 and runs in bursts to 1643.4, at the same high cat-calling pitch (about 310–380 Hz at 1638.0, 1640.4 and 1641.2) as «Хороший» at 1644.0 (about 311–334 Hz). Matcher's «Украина главный, пап!»@1780.7 is 'Dad! The main flag of Ukraine!', the line's third sentence, about 20 s in. Earlier speech matches the opening structure: «А вы ему как-то тут походите?»@1760.78 = 'and you … here', likely a mishearing of 'положите', for 'and you stack this here'. The vocals pitch there is child-range (about 300 Hz at 1761.0–1762.0), like «Украина главный, пап!» (about 290–320 Hz at 1781.0–1781.5), so it is the same child, Hek. It ends at «Украина главный!»@1785.08–1786.28, just before Dima's «Сейчас будем выходить»@1787.08. The order fits: 124 at 1742.4 («Я… перетаскован на своей локации» = 'hauled so many chairs at my station') ≤ 1757 ≤ 126 at 1787.08.

reader.summary: The funeral end of this stretch (132–135) and the kitchen talk (140, 143–148) are well evidenced by recognised words. The targeted passes also found two lines the matcher had only interpolated: Ian's Mariupol line at 2284.7 and the flag handover at 2201.9; and they moved 145, 146 and 135 to their real starts. The lullaby (137–139) is placed on singing onsets and a child's «Кто это стучит?» burst rather than on recognised lyrics; Frania's 142 and the background Transformers game (150–153) were not recognised at all. Those are order-only estimates, and the after-neighbour 154 really starts at about 2551.0, not 2559.59.

decisions.reason: The matcher's 2141 is interpolated. Its recognition text is the priest's «можете вийти і сказати… слова подяки», which says nothing about a flag, so it fails on meaning. The reader's claim rests on an unprompted t_vocals segment in whisper.json: «Просто@2204.56 прийняти@2204.96 (p .94) цю@2205.62 папу@2205.9». That is «прошу прийняти цей прапор», 'I ask you to accept this flag'. On the vocal stem, a near-silent gap at 2198.5–2201.5 (−86 dB at 2201.0) ends with speech at 2202.0 (−39.5 dB), voiced at about 180–216 Hz, the commander's range. The speech ends at 2206.5. The burst at 2196–2198 is at 320–364 Hz, so it is not the commander's «Dear family». My unprompted re-decodes of this window returned only «Дякую за перегляд!», so I am keeping medium rather than high. The start comes after 133 (2141) and before 135, inside the Hena-funeral layer (cue 46, to 2268).

Both claims point at the same priest speech, but the matcher's 2243.34 is in the middle of the line. Its own recognition text, «що в великій постаті героїзму і честі можете вийти і сказати… слова подяки, слова вдячності», is the second half. Earlier words of the same line are already recognised before 2243: t_plain «своєї@2235.0 держави, сину, своєї країнської родини, і кожен@2238.86, хто вповнений великою любов'ю@2242.7». That is 'a son of his nation, a son of his family. And anyone who holds great love'. My long-context vocal decode independently gives «…великої любові@2242.70, до великої постаті героїзму… слова вдячності, слова…» running to 2259.1. So the line starts well before 2235. The 'Today, we are gathered… our comrade' part was never recognised, even with a prompt (Whisper returns «Звучить музика»). The vocal stem shows a gap at 2209.5–2211.5 and then continuous speech-band energy from 2212.0. That speech has voiced frames at 132–174 Hz, the same range as the priest at 2234–2249, and pauses at 2225.5–2226.9 and 2233.5. I accept the reader's onset of 2212.2 but rate it low: from the speaking rate, the line could equally start about 2220 or 2227 if 2212–2225 is untranslated preamble or chant.

The matcher's 2259.46 is interpolated, and its recognition text is the priest's «ім'я прощання, слова подяки…», which is the wrong speech. My own unprompted ru decode of the vocal stem (2280–2296, level-normalised) reproduces the reader's hearing: «Типа@2284.70 все так радовались@2285.50 (p 1.00), ну как радовались, то есть еще не обстоятельство@2290.48, что он будет на полной улыбке@2292.44». That is 'everyone was so relieved… [по стечению] обстоятельств, that he [didn't end up in Mariupol]'. The line's opening ellipsis fits «Типа все так радовались». The stem is digitally silent at 2266.5–2273 and very quiet speech rises at 2284.5 and stops at 2293.0, so the start is in order between 135 and 137. The orchestrator's earlier verify run decoded with auto language and no level normalisation, and returned only «Субтитры сделал DimaTorzok».

The matcher's 2259.46 is interpolated onto the priest's «слова подяки, слова вдячності», so it is wrong in meaning, and it falls 90 s before the lullaby cue begins. No pass recognised the lyric. Every decode, including mine, returns hallucinations such as «Дякую!»@2358.55. The acoustic evidence holds up, though. The vocal stem is near-silent (−75 to −105 dB) from 2337 to 2354. A voice rises at 2354.5, then holds pitches the way singing does: 262–271 Hz across 2356–2358.5, 314–320 Hz across 2362.5–2364 and 235–239 Hz across 2376–2378.5. Cue 49 «Yak toy miud» ('like that honey', Sasha sings a lullaby) starts at 2349, and the English line opens with that same 'Like that honey'. I accept the singing onset, which is in order between 136 (2284.7) and 138 (2414.2).

The matcher's 2259.46 is interpolated onto the priest's speech, before cue 49 even starts, so it is refuted. The reader's wording «Кто это@2414.36 стучит@2414.54» comes only from a prompt-assisted pass. Unprompted decodes detect speech at exactly that point but no Russian words: «Nå er det styrtid» at 2413.78–2415.46 (er@2414.3, det@2414.44), t_plain «Nå er vi i bygget» (vi@2414.44), and my own «Субтитры подогнал»@2414.38. On the vocal stem, the loudest event in the window is a child-pitched burst at 2414.25–2414.75 (−33 dB, 391–405 Hz), trailing at 320–356 Hz to 2415.25. It sits between two of Sasha's sung phrases (229–291 Hz at 2408–2412 and 291–311 Hz from 2417.25). That fits a child (Frania) cutting into the lullaby, before 139 resumes. The timing is plausible, but the words are unconfirmed.

The matcher's 2259.46 is backed by the priest's «ім'я прощання, слова подяки…», which is the wrong speech and the wrong scene. The reader's t_vad «Остались@2483.76 только@2485.6 фотографии@2485.86 сообщения@2490.2» is confirmed by my unprompted vocal-stem decode: «Ну,@2483.36 то есть все, что осталось@2484.74, только@2485.64 … фотография@2487.02, да, сообщение@2490.42, все это просто@2491.44». «Ну, то есть» is the line's 'I mean', 'все, что осталось' is 'that's all that's left', and 'фотографии, сообщения' is 'the photos, the messages'. The vocal stem goes from silence (−82 dB at 2482.75) to speech at 2483.0. Speaker and topic fit cue 50 «Empty» (Katya shows Hena's phone, everything erased), and the time is in order after 138/139 and before 143.

The matcher's 2337.39 is interpolated, and its recognition text «Одно, наверное, здесь было тоже такое» is Katya's line 146. It would also put 143 before 140 (2483), breaking order. The reader cites t_vad in whisper.json: «на@2521.63 айфоне@2522.51 (p .89) просто@2523.39 есть@2523.65», 'on the iPhone there's just…', which is 'iPhones have this thing…'. The matcher's 2482.1 is interpolated on Katya's later «Я его когда начала включать…», which is the wrong line, and the time comes before 143, breaking order. The matcher's 2532.2 is anchored on «Одно/А, наверное, здесь было тоже такое, мне кажется», which is Katya's reply 'maybe that's what happened here too' (item 146), so it is the wrong line. reader.summary: Katya's lines (154, 156, 159, 160, 161, 164, 167, 169) match recognised speech closely and are timed from word timestamps. Several matcher starts were wrong: 154, 156, 159, 164 and 169 were late and 167 was early. The children's and Ian's interjections (155, 157, 158, 162, 163, 165, 166, 168) have no recognised words. They are placed in order from rough audio checks (child-pitched shouts, a male-range voice, the silent edit at 2616–2617) and stay low confidence, except 168, which Katya's «не перебивай» directly confirms.

decisions.reason: The line opens at «С одной стороны, у меня с британцами [с Бердянском] сказано [связано]»@2551.64; the other passes put it at 2551.22, 2551.44 and 2551.48. The rest follows in order: «каждая улочка, это вот все с Геном, с Геном, с Геном» (every little street… it's all Hena) and then «это наша жизнь»@2559.48–2559.72 (it's our life). This is the opening half of the pair that item 161 closes with «с другой стороны». The matcher's 2559.59 lands only on the last phrase, «Это наша жизнь», and the text it matched («чувства, эмоции, воспоминания, огород») belongs to item 156, so its claim fails on meaning. Neighbour 153 is an interpolated kids' line with no evidence of its own, so it does not block this start.

The line runs from «это наши чувства, это наши эмоции, это наши воспоминания»@2560.31 through «Это огород, который Гена плакал [посадил]»@2564.55 and «я так думаю, он нас туда просто не отпустит»@2567.7 (t_vad) to «Но это часть нашей жизни»@2575.59–2577.63, which is exactly the English. The matcher's 2578.27 is the end of «жизни», after the line is over, and the next words, «Я хочу, чтобы ребенок это помнил»@2578.41, open item 159. It fits playback order: after 155 (2559.9) and before 157 (2569.4).

'…and I want my child to remember it' is «Я хочу, чтобы ребенок это помнил»@2578.41 (2578.33 in t_vad). It is followed by «И как Гена хотел…»@2580.44, «То есть и Платоша»@2585.61, «мы вернемся сначала в [Бердянск]»@2589.79 and «летом там, зимой здесь»@2596.3–2597.25 (summers there, winters here). The matcher's 2582.63 is the end of «Не как Гена хотел в Фордянске», so it drops the first two sentences of the line. Order holds: after 158 (2574.9) and before 160 (2600.0).

The reader identified the right speech, «В общем, громадные часы… Гена вот так вот уперся… толкает в другую сторону, в обратную», followed by «у меня опять мурашки пошли»@2634.6, «После похорон вечером я девочкам рассказала этот сон»@2638.66 and «А на следующий день»@2644.89–2646.15. The targeted pass separates the two clock sentences: «Громадные вот такие часы»@2616.26 is item 162, Ian's «[Платоша]… Руль наоборот у тебя весь»@2619.58–2621.6 is item 163, and then the resumption «в общем, громадные часы» is item 164. The matcher's 2632.63 is the end of the clock sentence, which is the line's own opening, so it fails. I refined the start to 2623.4 because fresh decodes put the first word later: «В@2623.56 общем@2624.04» in the mix, «В@2623.98» and «общем@2623.40» in the vocal stem, with «громадные» at 2624.6 in every pass. Pitch agrees: about 160 Hz (Ian) until 2622.8, female 210–246 Hz from 2623.4. This fits the reader's own caveat.

'Don't interrupt' is «не перебивай»: t_vad has it at 2672.54, t_vocals at 2672.56 and p3 at 2672.66 (as «не перебивали»). 'Before the funeral it had stopped completely' is «Перед похоронами они вообще остановились»@2677.1, followed by «А вот это получается, как на следующий день они пошли в обратную сторону»@2679.4. The line closes with «Шли вперед, потом шли назад», «начала задавать вопросы Сонечку [Солнышку]», «ты меня слышишь?» and «Стрелка стоит, раз, назад сдвинулась»@2699.56–2701.14. The matcher's 2679.32 skips the first two sentences. On order: the vocal stem has a loud child-pitched burst (f0 400–500 Hz) at 2671.4–2672.4, then child-pitched «Он не выключается»@2675.0 for Platon's item 168. Platon therefore starts before Katya's «не перебивай», so this start is after 168 (2671.3).
